52.source: - **Efficiency** grants a 10% mining-speed bonus per level, stacking multiplicatively with <ItemLink id="overclocker_upgrade" />s, and raises power use by the same amount. Efficiency V makes the Quarry 1.5 times faster and uses 1.5 times the power.
52.translation: - **效率** 每级提供10%的采矿速度加成,并与<ItemLink id="overclocker_upgrade" />乘算叠加,同时按相同比例提高耗能.效率V可使采石场速度提高到1.5倍,耗能也变为1.5倍.
